CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION orulo_audit.pilot_targets()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(id order by id),'[]'::jsonb) from (
  select id from public.properties
  where state='SP' and source='novos' and active is true and raw_data->>'building_id'='43126'
  union all
  select id from public.properties
  where state='SP' and source='novos' and active is true and raw_data->>'building_id' is null
    and raw_data->'building'->>'id'='43126'
 ) candidates;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION orulo_audit.compare_legacy_v2(p_run uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with b as (select r->>0 id,r->>4 full_hash,r->>5 content_hash
 from orulo_audit.entries e cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(e.event->'snapshot'->'records') r
 where run_uuid=p_run and kind='BASELINE_V2'),
 a as (select r->>0 id,r->>4 full_hash,r->>5 content_hash
 from orulo_audit.entries e cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(e.event->'snapshot'->'records') r
 where run_uuid=p_run and kind='READBACK_V2')
 select jsonb_build_object('compared',count(*) filter(where b.id is not null and a.id is not null),
 'contentChanges',count(*) filter(where b.id is not null and a.id is not null and b.content_hash<>a.content_hash),
 'timestampOnly',count(*) filter(where b.content_hash=a.content_hash and b.full_hash<>a.full_hash),
 'insertions',count(*) filter(where b.id is null),'deletions',count(*) filter(where a.id is null),
 'schemaMatch',(select b.event->'snapshot'->'columns'=a.event->'snapshot'->'columns'
 from orulo_audit.entries b cross join orulo_audit.entries a where b.run_uuid=p_run and a.run_uuid=p_run and b.kind='BASELINE_V2' and a.kind='READBACK_V2'),
 'attribution','concurrent_or_unattributed_no_backfill_in_preflight')
 from b full join a using(id);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION orulo_audit.batch_has_image(p jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(exists(select 1 from unnest(array['image_url','url','2280x1800','1024x1024','520x280']) k where jsonb_typeof(p->k)='string' and length(p->>k)>0)
 or (jsonb_typeof(p->'images')='array' and p->'images'<>'[]'::jsonb),false);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION orulo_audit.batch_missing_ids(raw jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(p->>'id' order by p->>'id'),'[]'::jsonb)
 from jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(raw->'building'->'floor_plans')='array' then raw->'building'->'floor_plans' else '[]'::jsonb end)p where not orulo_audit.batch_has_image(p);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION orulo_audit.columns_v2()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(column_name,data_type) order by ordinal_position)
 from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name='properties';
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION orulo_audit.immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin raise exception 'AUDIT_APPEND_ONLY'; end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION orulo_audit.require_service()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if current_setting('role',true) is distinct from 'service_role' then
  raise insufficient_privilege using message='AUDIT_SERVICE_ROLE_REQUIRED';
 end if;
end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orulo_media_cas(p_id uuid, p_expected jsonb, p_floor_plans jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin raise exception 'AUDITED_CAS_REQUIRED'; end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION orulo_audit.snapshot_rows()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object('snapshotAt',statement_timestamp(),'key','id',
 'recordFormat',jsonb_build_array('id','external_id','building_id','updated_at_utc','full_hash','content_hash'),
 'excludedContentFields',jsonb_build_array('updated_at'),
 'algorithm','MD5 PostgreSQL canonical JSONB; timestamps UTC',
 'columns',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(column_name,data_type) order by ordinal_position)
 from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name='properties'),
 'records',coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(p.id::text,p.external_id,
 coalesce(p.raw_data->>'building_id',p.raw_data->'building'->>'id',''),p.updated_at at time zone 'UTC',
 md5(c.row::text),md5((c.row-'updated_at')::text)) order by p.id),'[]'::jsonb))
 from public.properties p cross join lateral (select to_jsonb(p)||jsonb_build_object(
 'created_at',p.created_at at time zone 'UTC','updated_at',p.updated_at at time zone 'UTC') as row) c;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION orulo_audit.lock_run(p_run uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if not pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(p_run::text,0)) then raise exception 'AUDIT_CONCURRENT_ACCESS'; end if;
 if not exists(select 1 from orulo_audit.runs where run_uuid=p_run) then raise exception 'AUDIT_RUN_NOT_FOUND'; end if;
end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION orulo_audit.compare_v2(p_run uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with b as(select id,record from orulo_audit.snapshot_records where run_uuid=p_run and kind='BASELINE_V2' and record->>4 is not null),
 a as(select id,record from orulo_audit.snapshot_records where run_uuid=p_run and kind='READBACK_V2' and record->>4 is not null)
 select case when not exists(select 1 from orulo_audit.snapshot_sets where run_uuid=p_run)
 then orulo_audit.compare_legacy_v2(p_run) else jsonb_build_object(
 'compared',count(*) filter(where b.id is not null and a.id is not null),
 'contentChanges',count(*) filter(where b.id is not null and a.id is not null and b.record->>5<>a.record->>5),
 'timestampOnly',count(*) filter(where b.record->>5=a.record->>5 and b.record->>4<>a.record->>4),
 'insertions',count(*) filter(where b.id is null),'deletions',count(*) filter(where a.id is null),
 'schemaMatch',(select b.columns=a.columns from orulo_audit.snapshot_sets b join orulo_audit.snapshot_sets a using(run_uuid) where b.run_uuid=p_run and b.kind='BASELINE_V2' and a.kind='READBACK_V2'),
 'captureStable',not exists(select 1 from orulo_audit.entries where run_uuid=p_run and kind in ('BASELINE_V2','READBACK_V2') and event->'snapshot'->>'membershipStable' is distinct from 'true'),
 'attribution','concurrent_or_unattributed_no_backfill_in_preflight') end
 from b full join a using(id);
$function$
